title: PbfuzzState
description: `.pbfuzz/<id>/state/state.json` — the PIER cursor. Written ONLY by pbfuzz's own tools (`pbfuzz_campaign selfcheck`, `pbfuzz_plan`, `pbfuzz_fuzz`, `pbfuzz_reflect`) through `PbfuzzHost.advancePhase()`, which enforces the FSM, the INIT gate and the loop budget before the write lands. A direct agent `write`/`edit` under the campaign's state directory is denied by the host's `ctx.tools.guard()` and pointed at the tool that owns this file.

phase.description: INIT covers the questionnaire, canary insertion and the self-check. SUCCESS means a PoV was produced; STOPPED means the budget or wall clock ran out. Legal transitions: INIT→PLAN (gated), PLAN→IMPLEMENT→EXECUTE→REFLECT, REFLECT→PLAN (budget-gated), REFLECT→SUCCESS, any→STOPPED.

status.description: One line on where the run stands.

pier_round.description: Completed PLAN→REFLECT cycles. `state-writer.ts`'s `advancePhase()` redirects a REFLECT→PLAN request to STOPPED once this reaches `maxPierRounds`, instead of the caller-requested PLAN.
